name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: Type to filter a list and pick one option.
a11y: ARIA 1.2 combobox: the input has role="combobox" with aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant.
ArrowDown/ArrowUp move through options, Enter picks, Escape closes (and clears the typed text on a second press), Tab leaves.
Options are in a listbox with aria-selected; an empty result is announced as text.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices, each with a `value`, a `label` and an optional `disabled`. The user filters them by typing part of the label.

props.name: value
props.description: The selected option's `value` when controlled; `''` means none. Pair with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initially selected option's `value` when uncontrolled. Default none.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the chosen option's value, or '' when cleared.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name. A hidden input submits the chosen option `value` (not its label); the visible text box is not submitted.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` (default), `sm` for dense layouts or `lg` for prominent forms. Heights match Button, Input and Select at each size.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field as having an error: sets `aria-invalid` and shows the error border.
